x: First home was Brian Adams (Leicester) in 19:57.6 followed by Olly Flynn (Basildon), Peter Marlow (Southend) and Roger Mills (Ilford) so Carl was in very good company.

Three Belgravians competed in the City of London New Year's Day race over three miles, won by Leicester's B.Adams in 19:57.6. Fifth was Carl Lawton 20:53.6 with R.Tanner 22nd in 22:52 and R.Middleton 27th in 23:25.

The only British Record held by a Belgravian was taken from us recently when Brian Adams of Leicester scorched to a 2 mile walk time of 12:52.6, taking 9.8 seconds from the mark set by Stan Vickers at the White City in 1960.

They are in good company, our own champion, Carl, could claim a place in our cross country or road relay teams by virtue of his running performances. Other top class walkers who also take part in running events include Brian Adams, Christine Coleman, Judy Farr and Roger Mills.

After five kilos Olly Flynn, Roger Mills and Brian Adams were away battling for Individual honours and they finished in that order. Then came the leading group which contained Carl and Graham, Ray soon appeared but where was our fourth man?

Individually the race was a triumph for Brian Adams (Leicester W.C.) making his debut over the distance on the road. For a long way he was in the lead with Jake Warhurst (Sheffield) but eventually got away, although the Sheffield man was pulling him back towards the end Sheffield won the team title…

Leicester's Brian Adams was first home in 43:22 but the Bels were well to the fore with - 3.C.Lawton 43:58; 5.G. Seatter 45:20; 9.J.Hall 45:58; 25.R.Middleton 47:55; 46.J.Bromley 50:40; 47.J.Dunsford 50:43; 49.R.Picton 50:46; 63.N.Morris 52:18; 106.T.Cook 56:48.

Jobin passed by in 1:09:27 and Graham was up to 4th in 1:10:05, 24 seconds clear of Brian Adams with Erikson apparently fading. Adams took Graham (1:35:55) in the next 5Km stretch and then up front Flynn moved into a lead he was to maintain to the end.

Two Belgravians fought it out for the bronze medal with Carl just prevailing over Graham Seatter by three tenths of a second, 12:41.12 to 12:41.42. The race was won by Ilford's Roger Mills in 12:05.07 from Brian Adams of Leicester, 12:24.72.
To the race itself, the early leaders were Olly Flynn, Mike Parker, Brian Adams and Amos Seddon with Carl not too far back. The team race looked good for Ilford A.C. who had many well up.
John Keown yet again was left to go it alone for Belgrave. Result; 1.B.Adams (Leics) 8:37.30; 14.J.Keown 10:24.33.
